integrity_notes: Proof supplied casewise in every characteristic; mathematical self-review performed; no independent audit or external certification claimed.
limitations: Existence theorem for field gonality only; these curves become trigonal over an algebraic closure. It does not count isomorphism classes, zeta functions, or generalize to other genera. The supplied exact Gröbner calculations test selected prime fields; characteristic-uniform proof is algebraic. Bibliographic originality retains the risk of unindexed equivalent constructions.
title: Four-gonal genus-four curves over every finite field
